description: Defines interfaces and classes for Android input driver, including InputDriverInterface and InputDriver, with functions for device and report management, and external C functions for device creation and property handling.

classes.name: InputDriverInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for input driver operations, including device and report management, property handling, and dumping info.

classes.name: InputDriver
classes.description: Concrete implementation of InputDriverInterface, managing input devices and reports with internal state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the input driver.

methods.name: createDeviceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a device identifier with specified parameters.

methods.name: createDeviceDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new device definition.

methods.name: createInputReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new input report definition.

methods.name: createOutputReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new output report definition.

methods.name: freeReportDefinition
methods.description: Frees a report definition.

methods.name: inputDeviceDefinitionAddReport
methods.description: Adds a report to a device definition.

methods.name: inputReportDefinitionAddCollection
methods.description: Adds a collection to a report definition.

methods.name: inputReportDefinitionDeclareUsageInt
methods.description: Declares an integer usage in a report definition.

methods.name: inputReportDefinitionDeclareUsagesBool
methods.description: Declares boolean usages in a report definition.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a device with the input system.

methods.name: unregisterDevice
methods.description: Unregisters a device handle.

methods.name: inputAllocateReport
methods.description: Allocates a report based on a report definition.

methods.name: inputReportSetUsageInt
methods.description: Sets an integer usage value in a report.

methods.name: inputReportSetUsageBool
methods.description: Sets a boolean usage value in a report.

methods.name: reportEvent
methods.description: Reports an input event from a device.

methods.name: inputGetDevicePropertyMap
methods.description: Retrieves the property map for a device.

methods.name: inputGetDeviceProperty
methods.description: Gets a specific property from a device property map.

methods.name: inputGetPropertyKey
methods.description: Gets the key of a property.

methods.name: inputGetPropertyValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a property.

methods.name: inputFreeDeviceProperty
methods.description: Frees a device property.

methods.name: inputFreeDevicePropertyMap
methods.description: Frees a device property map.
